flags.question: What are the 3 most recent questions asked by the user with the highest reputation?
flags.cypher:
// Step 1: Find the user with the highest reputation
MATCH (u:User)
WITH u
ORDER BY u.reputation DESC
LIMIT 1

// Step 2: Find the questions asked by this user
MATCH (u)-[:ASKED]->(q:Question)
WITH q
ORDER BY q.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 3

// Step 3: Return the details of the 3 most recent questions
RETURN q.title AS title, q.text AS text, q.link AS link, q.createdAt AS createdAt

flags.question: Identify the first 3 users whose questions have never been downVoted.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (u:User)-[:ASKED]->(q:Question)
WHERE q.downVotes = 0
RETURN u.display_name, u.id, u.link
LIMIT 3
details: Question implies negation but TypeQL has no not{} block

flags.question: What are the first 3 questions asked by the user with the highest reputation?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (u:User)-[:ASKED]->(q:Question)
WITH u, q
ORDER BY u.reputation DESC
LIMIT 1
WITH u, q
ORDER BY q.createdAt ASC
LIMIT 3
RETURN q.title, q.link, q.createdAt

flags.question: Identify the first 3 questions asked by the newest user in the database.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (u:User)-[:ASKED]->(q:Question)
WITH u, q
ORDER BY u.id DESC, q.createdAt ASC
WITH u, collect(q)[..3] AS first_three_questions
RETURN u.display_name AS newest_user, first_three_questions
details: Cypher sorts DESC but TypeQL sorts ASC (default)

flags.question: What are the top 5 questions asked by users with the most questions in the database?
flags.cypher:
// Step 1: Find the users who have asked the most questions
MATCH (u:User)-[:ASKED]->(q:Question)
WITH u, COUNT(q) AS question_count
ORDER BY question_count DESC
LIMIT 5

// Step 2: For each of these top users, find their questions
MATCH (u)-[:ASKED]->(q:Question)
RETURN u.display_name AS user, q.title AS question_title, q.link AS question_link
ORDER BY u.display_name, q.createdAt DESC
details: Cypher sorts DESC but TypeQL sorts ASC (default)

flags.question: What are the first 3 questions asked by the user with the lowest reputation?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (u:User)-[:ASKED]->(q:Question)
WITH u, q
ORDER BY u.reputation ASC
LIMIT 1
WITH u, q
ORDER BY q.createdAt ASC
LIMIT 3
RETURN q.title, q.createdAt, q.link

flags.question: Which users have never received a downvote on their questions?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (u:User)-[:ASKED]->(q:Question)
WHERE q.downVotes = 0
RETURN DISTINCT u.display_name, u.id, u.link
details: Question implies negation but TypeQL has no not{} block

flags.question: Which 3 tags are associated with questions that have the highest favorites?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (q:Question)-[:TAGGED]->(t:Tag)
WITH q, t
ORDER BY q.favorites DESC
LIMIT 3
RETURN t.name AS tag, COUNT(q) AS question_count
ORDER BY question_count DESC
LIMIT 3
details: Cypher uses COUNT() but TypeQL has no count

flags.question: Identify the 3 users who have asked the most questions without any upVotes.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (u:User)-[:ASKED]->(q:Question)
WHERE q.upVotes = 0
WITH u, COUNT(q) AS question_count
ORDER BY question_count DESC
LIMIT 3
RETURN u.display_name AS user, question_count
details: Question implies negation but TypeQL has no not{} block

flags.question: List 3 users who have never been downvoted on their questions.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (u:User)-[:ASKED]->(q:Question)
WHERE q.downVotes = 0
WITH u, COUNT(q) AS questionCount
MATCH (u)-[:ASKED]->(q2:Question)
WITH u, questionCount, COUNT(q2) AS totalQuestions
WHERE questionCount = totalQuestions
RETURN u.display_name AS userName, u.id AS userId, u.link AS userLink
LIMIT 3
details: Cypher uses COUNT() but TypeQL has no count
